checklistGeneric: Log the item in the GRC platform with a unique tracking number
Confirm owner and due date are assigned
checklistSpecific: Log the request in the DSAR intake queue with channel (web form, email, phone, mail) and receipt timestamp

Send the requestor an acknowledgment confirming receipt and expected response window

checklistGeneric: Record the classification decision and rationale
Confirm the classification field is populated before routing

testing.expected: Request type classified and case routed to the matching sub-queue

checklistGeneric: Cite the specific statute and section relied upon
Record the deadline calculation method used
checklistSpecific: Determine requestor's home-state or residency jurisdiction from the intake record
Identify the applicable statute (e.g. CCPA, state insurance privacy regulation, GLBA-state variant)
Calculate the statutory response deadline (e.g. 45-day CCPA, 30-day GLBA-state variant) from receipt date
Record the deadline in the DSAR case record and set a reminder ahead of the due date
Note any permitted extension basis and revised deadline if the case qualifies

testing.expected: Applicable law and calculated statutory deadline recorded on the case

checklistGeneric: Record the verification method used
Confirm identity evidence is attached to the case
checklistSpecific: Apply the identity-verification method matching the request's sensitivity tier (knowledge-based vs. document upload)
Match requestor-supplied identifiers (name, DOB, policy/claim number) against systems of record
For an authorized agent, confirm power of attorney or written authorization on file
Reject and request additional proof if verification fails, logging the reason
Mark the case as identity-verified with verifier name and timestamp before data location begins

testing.expected: Verification method, evidence and verifier recorded before the case proceeds

checklistGeneric: Record each system searched and search date

Search policy, claims, billing and marketing systems of record for matching records

checklistGeneric: Confirm the package is stored in the secure DSAR case folder
